title: BetterDeaths-API
description: AN API FOR MODS PLEASE ASK FOR PERMISSION BEFORE DEPENDENCY ADDED. Adds Death Procedural Code Templates.
body:
**THIS API REQUIRES EXPRESS WRITTEN CONSENT FOR USE AS AN API**

This api makes coding custom deaths easier, in some ways.

This api also acts as a neo-forgified paper-api.

# Notice

I, Jackie The Coder, quit modding. Because no one thanks me enough or support me to feel like I have made what i should have.

If you wish to have my mods, sorry but you have to support me on patreon or Ko-fi once it's ready.
